name: Heal-A2Z Syrup
description: Heal-A2Z Syrup is a comprehensive multivitamin, multimineral, and antioxidant supplement designed to bridge nutritional gaps. It supports immunity, neutralizes free radicals, and aids in overall physiological health. Ideal for all age groups, especially beneficial for those recovering from illness, surgery, or injury.

name: Cephopod-CV Tablets
description: Cefpod Cv Tablet is an antibiotic that is used to treat infection of the urinary tract, lungs, airways, sinus, throat and windpipe. It is a combination medicine containing cefpodoxime and clavulanic acid as its active ingredients. It acts by the combined action of its two components. Cefpodoxime inhibits the growth of bacteria by interfering with the cell wall and clavulanic acid helps in maintaining the optimal levels of Cefpodoxime. It should be taken as directed by the doctor and in doses and duration as prescribed. Complete the course of antibiotics and do not miss any dose or stop taking this medicine on your own. Before using Cefpod Cv Tablet, inform the doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy or are breastfeeding and about your detailed medical history.

name: Gastrolab Gel Suspension
description: Gastrolab Gel, formulated with Dried Aluminium Hydroxide, Magnesium Hydroxide, and Simethicone Suspension, provides quick relief from excess stomach acid. It neutralizes acidity to alleviate symptoms of ulcers, heartburn, and dyspepsia, while its laxative effect prevents constipation. The gel also eases pain and irritation in the esophagus, making it effective for conditions like dyspepsia, hyperacidity, peptic ulcers, gastritis, and esophageal reflux.

name: Gastrolab-DSR
description: Gastorab-DSR Capsule is a combination medicine used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease (Acid reflux). It works by relieving the symptoms of acidity such as heartburn, stomach pain, or irritation. It also neutralizes the acid and promotes easy passage of gas to reduce stomach discomfort.

name: Ascolab-LS Junior Syrup
description: ASCOLAB-LS JUNIOR Syrup is a pediatric medicine used to relieve cough and other respiratory symptoms in children. It combines a blend of effective ingredients that help soothe the throat, reduce coughing, and ease breathing discomfort caused by colds or allergies. ASCOLAB-LS JUNIOR provides relief from both dry and productive coughs, promoting better airflow and reducing irritation.

name: Coldheal-Forte Syrup
description: Coldheal-Forte is a stronger formulation of Paracetamol, Phenylephrine HCl, and Chlorpheniramine suspension. It provides balanced relief for severe symptoms of cold and cough, reducing nasal and bronchial congestion. The anti-histaminic properties alleviate constriction and discomfort associated with respiratory issues. Indications include cold, fever, nasal congestion, and allergic rhinitis.

name: Ascolab-DX Syrup
description: ASCOLAB-DX Syrup is a pediatric formulation designed to relieve symptoms of cough, cold, and respiratory congestion in children. It helps soothe the throat, reduce coughing, and clear nasal congestion. ASCOLAB-DX Syrup is effective in managing both dry and productive coughs, while promoting easier breathing. The syrup's blend of ingredients works quickly to provide relief from discomfort caused by colds, flu, and respiratory infections.

name: Ascolab-LS 100ML Syrup
description: ASCOLAB-LS Syrup is a pediatric syrup used to treat cough and cold symptoms in children. It helps relieve irritation in the throat, reduces coughing, and clears congestion. The syrup is effective for both dry and productive coughs, easing breathing and soothing the respiratory tract. ASCOLAB-LS is formulated to provide quick relief from discomfort caused by colds, flu, or allergies.

name: Healofinac-P Tablets
description: HEALOFINAC-P is a combination medicine used to relieve pain and inflammation in children. It contains Paracetamol (for pain relief and fever reduction) and Ibuprofen (for reducing inflammation and swelling). This syrup is commonly used for conditions like fever, headaches, body aches, and minor injuries. It helps provide quick relief from discomfort while also lowering body temperature.

name: Healocef-200 Tablets
description: HEALOCEF-200 is an antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections in children. It contains Cefuroxime, a broad-spectrum antibiotic that works by inhibiting the growth of bacteria. HEALOCEF-200 is effective for treating infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear infections, skin infections, and urinary tract infections. It helps reduce symptoms like fever, pain, and swelling.

name: Healoflox-OZ Tablets
description: HEALOFLOX-OZ is an antibiotic combination used to treat a wide range of bacterial infections in children. It contains Ofloxacin, a fluoroquinolone antibiotic, and Ornidazole, an anti-protozoal, which work together to target both bacterial and parasitic infections. This combination is commonly used for treating infections in the respiratory tract, gastrointestinal system, urinary tract, and skin.

name: Montoheal-LC Tablets
description: MONTOHEAL-LC, contains Levocetirizine and Montelukast. Levocetirizine reduces symptoms like rhinorrhea, nasal/eye itching, and sneezing while improving nasal patency and reducing inflammation. Montelukast acts as a leukotriene receptor inhibitor, decreasing nasal congestion and improving sleep quality. It is indicated for treating seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis, chronic urticaria, watery eyes, and providing long-term management of asthma, offering relief from recurrent allergic reactions.

name: Heal-A2Z Capsules
description: A to Z NS+ Tablet is a dietary supplement formulated with multivitamins, multi-minerals and lycopene that support the immune system. It is rich in antioxidants that protect the body against free radicals. It promotes skin and bone health and strengthens immunity.

name: Healomyncin-500 Tablets
description: HEALOMYNCIN-500 is an antibiotic used to treat a variety of bacterial infections in children and adults. It contains Azithromycin, a broad-spectrum antibiotic that works by inhibiting bacterial growth. HEALOMYNCIN-500 is commonly prescribed for respiratory infections, ear infections, skin infections, and certain sexually transmitted infections. It is known for its effectiveness in treating infections with a shorter duration of treatment.

name: Healocef-100 Suspension
description: Healocef-100: Formulated with Cefixime 100 mg, this dry syrup is suitable for upper and lower respiratory tract infections, urinary infections, and soft tissue infections. It offers broad-spectrum coverage, high stability, and is ideal for transition therapy in pediatric care.

name: Healocef-50 Suspension
description: Healocef-50: This Cefixime 50 mg dry syrup is a third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic, effective against a broad range of bacteria, including Enterobacteria, H. Influenzae, and S. Pneumoniae. Ideal for pediatric patients, it treats infections like pneumonia, typhoid, and sinusitis with stability against beta-lactamase.

name: Healofinax-SP
description: Healofinac-SP combines Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase to repair tissues and reduce inflammation. Aceclofenac supports cartilage health, Paracetamol provides pain relief, and Serratiopeptidase reduces swelling and improves micro-circulation for faster healing, ideal for conditions like dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, and postoperative pain.

name: Gastrolab-IV Injection
description: Gastrolab-IV (Pantoprazole 40 mg for Injection) provides rapid, effective control of gastric hyperacidity and heartburn in patients with acute or chronic gastritis, GERD, and peptic ulcers. It reduces gastric acid secretion, lowers ulcer bleeding risk, and shortens hospital stays by promoting faster symptom relief. This injection offers targeted, immediate relief for critical acid-related conditions.

name: Morbeheal-DDS Suspension
description: MORBEHEAL DDS features Amoxycillin + Potassium Clavulanate Oral Suspension (457 mg) and is highly effective against strains of Haemophilus influenzae. It is specifically recommended for treating infections such as ENT, respiratory, urinary tract, skin and soft tissue, dental, and bone and joint infections. The medicine is backed by clinical evidence, establishing it as a credible antibiotic option for pediatric patients.

name: Montoheal-LC Suspension
description: MONTOHEAL-LC, a combination of Montelukast Sodium and Levocetirizine Hydrochloride, is a broad-spectrum anti-allergy solution. Levocetirizine relieves nasal congestion, while Montelukast reduces inflammation. It provides bronchodilation within two hours, easing symptoms like coughing and wheezing. It is ideal for managing seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis, mild to moderate asthma, and nasal congestion.

name: Morbeheal-CV 625
description: MORBEHEAL-CV 625 Tablet is used for the treatment of various bacterial infections such as infection of lungs, airways, ears, urinary tract, skin, bone, joints, soft tissue and tooth. It is a combination medicine containing amoxicillin and clavulanic acid, which belongs to the class of antibiotics.

name: Febriheal-250 Suspension
description: Febriheal-250 offers quick and effective relief from pain and fever. Its blend of paracetamol, phenylephrine, and chlorpheniramine helps reduce discomfort, controls swelling, and restores a sense of well-being. Specially formulated for children, it safely addresses symptoms and brings rapid comfort. Trusted by caregivers, Febriheal-250 is a reliable solution for managing fever and body aches.

name: Coldeheal Syrup
description: Coldheal is a suspension containing Paracetamol, Phenylephrine HCl, and Chlorpheniramine, designed to alleviate symptoms of cold and cough. It effectively reduces the frequency and intensity of coughs and colds. The anti-histaminic action of Chlorpheniramine helps relieve itching and nasal congestion. This medicine is indicated for cold, fever, runny nose, and allergic rhinitis.

name: Emeheal-4mg Injection
description: Emeheal Injection, containing Ondansetron 4 mg, is a reliable solution for managing nausea and vomiting from various causes. This fast-acting anti-emetic is highly effective in post-operative care, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy. With a proven safety profile, Emeheal provides rapid relief and enhances patient comfort. It’s widely trusted for its efficacy in treating gastroenteritis, dyspepsia, and other nausea-related conditions.

name: Morbeheal-Duo Suspension
description: MORBEHEAL DUO contains Amoxycillin + Potassium Clavulanate Oral Suspension (228.5 mg). It offers effective antibacterial coverage, especially against Beta-lactamase-producing pathogens, while providing a favorable pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic profile. The formulation is clinically and bacteriologically superior to Amoxycillin alone, making it a reliable choice for various pediatric infections.

name: Febriheal-Plus Suspension
description: Febriheal-Plus suspension combines Paracetamol, Phenylephrine HCl, and Chlorpheniramine to address a variety of pain and inflammation sources. Paracetamol selectively inhibits COX-3 enzymes in the brain and spinal cord, offering effective pain relief, while Ibuprofen blocks COX enzymes that cause inflammation. It’s indicated for treating sore throat, dental pain, headaches, ear pain, and fever, providing a safe and balanced anti-pyretic and anti-inflammatory solution for children.

name: Cephopod-CV 100 Suspension
description: efhopod CV-100 is a higher-strength dry syrup formulation of Cefpodoxime Proxetil and Potassium Clavulanate. It is intended for the treatment of conditions like pharyngitis, tonsillitis, pneumonia, and typhoid fever. Cefpodoxime disrupts bacterial defenses, aiding in the control of infections. Potassium Clavulanate decreases bacterial resistance, thereby boosting the antibiotic’s efficacy.

name: Healocef-SB 1.5 Injection
description: Healocef-SB 1.5 combines Ceftriaxone and Sulbactam for a powerful, broad-spectrum antibiotic effect. Ceftriaxone is effective against Pseudomonas aeruginosa, while Sulbactam protects it from degradation, enhancing its spectrum. This duo is ideal for surgical prophylaxis, nosocmial infections, sepsis, and bacterial meningitis.

name: Cephopod-CV 50 Dry Syrup
description: Cefhopod CV-50 is a dry syrup that combines Cefpodoxime Proxetil with Potassium Clavulanate. It is effective in treating infections such as acute otitis media and chronic bronchitis. Cefpodoxime works by inhibiting the bacterial protective layers, which prevents bacterial growth. Potassium Clavulanate complements this by inhibiting beta-lactamase enzymes, enhancing the effectiveness of Cefpodoxime.

name: Coldheal Tablets
description: This tablet formulation combines Paracetamol, Guaifenesin, Phenylephrine HCl, Ambroxol, and Cetirizine to address a wide range of cold and respiratory symptoms. It effectively reduces nasal congestion, body aches, and headaches while also alleviating bronchospasm. Ambroxol helps loosen mucus, while Cetirizine provides antihistamine action to reduce allergic symptoms. Ideal for adults with persistent cold and chest congestion.

name: Gastrolab-40 Tablets
description: Gastrolab-40 (Pantoprazole 40 mg) provides effective, long-lasting relief from acid peptic disorders by irreversibly inhibiting the proton pump. This medication offers 24-hour suppression of gastric acid, helping to heal and prevent symptoms associated with GERD, gastric ulcers, and hypersecretory conditions. Its once-daily dosing improves patient compliance and supports faster recovery.

name: Cephopod-200 Tablets
description: Cephopod 200 contains 200 mg of Cefpodoxime Proxetil in dispersible tablet form. It has shown high cure rates for acute maxillary sinusitis and acute tonsillopharyngitis, with favorable safety and tolerability. This medication is suitable for treating nosocomial infections, resistant respiratory tract infections (RTI), and skin and soft tissue infections.

name: Healofinac-MR Tablets
description: HEALOFINAC-MR is a combination medication used to provide relief from pain and inflammation. It contains Aceclofenac, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), and Methocarbamol, a muscle relaxant. This combination is effective in treating conditions associated with musculoskeletal pain, such as muscle spasms, joint pain. HEALOFINAC-MR works by reducing inflammation and relieving muscle stiffness, helping to improve mobility and alleviate discomfort.

name: Healofinac-P
description: Healofinac-P is a combination of Aceclofenac and Paracetamol, providing effective relief from pain and inflammation. It is commonly used to treat conditions like arthritis, muscle pain, and fever.

name: Heal-A2Z Nerve Injection
description: Heal-A2Z Nerve Injection contains Methylcobalamin, Pyridoxine HCl, and Niacinamide, essential for nerve health and vitamin deficiencies. It supports nerve regeneration, reduces neuropathic pain, and improves overall neurological function.

name: Febriheal-MP Forte Suspension
description: Febriheal-MP Forte Suspension combines Paracetamol and Mefenamic Acid to provide effective relief from fever and pain in children. It helps reduce inflammation and discomfort caused by infections, teething, and other mild to moderate conditions

name: Emeheal-2mg Drops
description: Emeheal-2MG Drops contain Ondansetron, an effective anti-nausea medication that helps prevent vomiting caused by infections, chemotherapy, or post-surgery recovery. It is commonly used for children to provide quick relief from nausea and motion sickness.

name: Febriheal-MP Suspension
description: Febriheal-MP Suspension is a combination of Mefenamic Acid and Paracetamol, designed to provide relief from fever, pain, and inflammation in children. It is commonly used to treat teething pain, ear infections, and other mild to moderate conditions.

name: Healocef-1 Gm Injection
description: Healocef-1 gm Injection contains Ceftriaxone, a broad-spectrum antibiotic used to treat severe bacterial infections. It is administered via IV or IM to combat respiratory, urinary, and skin infections effectively.
